description: top-down pixel art game board background seen from above at a slight angle: the floor of a vast infernal underground labyrinth hall, cracked black and dark red volcanic stone flagstones, thin glowing orange-red cracks with lava light between them, faint red glowing rune lines etched into the floor, a dark stone archway with jagged horns in the middle of the top edge, worn stone steps leading in at the middle of the bottom edge, dark broken pillars and walls along the left and right edges fading into black smoke, a wide empty open floor in the middle, muted dark palette of black, deep crimson and ember orange, low contrast so game pieces placed on top stand out, no characters, no creatures, no text
